views.jql: summary ~ "Security Exception" ORDER BY updated DESC
views.name: Security Exceptions

views.jql: summary ~ "Governance Exception" ORDER BY updated DESC
views.name: Governance Exceptions

views.jql: project = MUON ORDER BY updated DESC
views.name: Platform Backlog

views.jql: sprint in openSprints() ORDER BY priority DESC, updated DESC
views.name: Current Sprint

views.jql: assignee is EMPTY AND resolution is EMPTY ORDER BY updated DESC
views.name: Unassigned Work

views.jql: updated <= -90d AND resolution is EMPTY ORDER BY updated ASC
views.name: Stale Backlog

views.jql: description is EMPTY AND resolution is EMPTY ORDER BY updated DESC
views.name: Low Quality Tickets

views.jql: summary ~ "Operational Security Issue" ORDER BY updated DESC
views.name: Operational Security Issues
